description: Turn the optional mine dead end into one authored grue-colony site with targetable fissures while leaving all other dark rooms canonical.

replacements.old:
<ROOM DEAD-END-5	;"was DEAD7"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Dead End")
      (LDESC "You have come to a dead end in the mine.")
      (NORTH TO LADDER-BOTTOM)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT)>

<ROOM DEAD-END-5	;"was DEAD7"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Dead End")
      (ACTION GRUE-COLONY-ROOM-FCN)
      (NORTH TO LADDER-BOTTOM)

<OBJECT GRUE-FISSSURES
        (IN DEAD-END-5)
